mechanism: Both drugs reduce glomerular filtration rate and renal perfusion; losartan decreases efferent arteriolar vasoconstriction while gentamicin is nephrotoxic, synergistically increasing acute kidney injury risk.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; adjust gentamicin dosing based on renal function and therapeutic drug monitoring.
